name: Cancer and Cell Biology PhD
detailsNote: Annual dates are not explicitly assigned a year. The doctoral application section specifies July entry; the overview inconsistently says fall.

publishedDeadlines.label: Early consideration
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual early interview and decision consideration.

publishedDeadlines.label: Final deadline
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual deadline for the following summer cohort.

applicationFee.note: International $70; domestic $65. Automatic waiver only for current or former US armed-forces service; overseas applicants must confirm qualification.

english.note: Program requires official scores before review, valid two years. PTE 54; home tests accepted; TOEFL Essentials/MyBest excluded. Central exemption policy also applies.

documents: After accepting enrollment: foreign bachelor’s degree requires a general/document-by-document NACES evaluation sent directly by the evaluator before the first term; US bachelor’s degrees exempt
requirements.note: Bachelor degree by July 1; GPA at least 3.0; strong biology, chemistry and/or physics and mathematics. GRE or MCAT and a one-minute video essay are recommended but optional. First rotation starts shortly after July 4; selected interviews generally January–February, offers January–April.

funding.note: All accepted PhD students receive full tuition remission, a competitive stipend and health insurance; no amount or future-year rate stated.
